name: The House Wins
flavor: Everyone gets a run. Nobody gets to keep it. You are simply the one who decides when the table closes.
description: You call in everything a creature's luck has been borrowing. One creature you can see within range makes a Dexterity saving throw against your {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}. On a failure it takes [[3d6]] physical damage and has disadvantage on the next d20 it rolls before the start of your next turn; on a success it takes half as much damage and rolls normally. Casting this costs 2 Mirth, spent as you cast; like every costed Turn it generates none back.
narration: Its run of luck does not end so much as get repossessed, all at once, with interest — and for a moment afterwards nothing it tries quite works either.
sheetSummary: Action, 60 ft, cooldown 3, costs 2 Mirth. Dexterity save vs {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}. Fail: [[3d6]] physical and disadvantage on its next d20 before the start of your next turn. Success: half damage only.
